name: Internal Linking
description: Counts same-host links on the page, separating navigation (nav/header/footer) from in-content links, and penalises generic anchor text such as 'click here' in content. Internal links with descriptive anchors help AI crawlers understand site topology and what each linked page is about.
inputs: rendered DOM: all a[href] elements, their href attribute, innerText and ancestor nav/header/footer/[role=navigation]

scoring.summary: Start at 4. Internal = a[href] whose href is not mailto:/tel:/javascript:/# and whose resolved http(s) hostname equals the page hostname ignoring a leading 'www.' (page URL from the site base URL; relative links are always internal). 0 internal links -> -3. Else if content links < 3 AND total internal < 5 -> -1. Generic anchor text on content (non-nav) links -> -0.25 each, max -1. Anchor text falls back to aria-label, img alt, then title when the link has no text. Score = max(0, round to 1 decimal); the engine floors it. Broken targets are not checked here (see /aeotester:links).

rules.condition: href attribute (trimmed) not starting with 'mailto:', 'tel:', 'javascript:' or '#', and new URL(href, pageUrl) is http(s) with hostname equal to the page hostname after stripping a leading 'www.' from both (other subdomains are external). pageUrl uses the site base URL (canonical, og:url, sitemap, CNAME, config) or a placeholder host, so relative links are always internal.
link.closest('nav, header, footer, [role="navigation"]') -> nav link; otherwise content link

text = visible text (innerText approximation) trimmed and lowercased, or when empty: aria-label, then the first non-empty img alt, then title; generic if length < 2 or exactly one of: 'click here', 'here', 'read more', 'more', 'link', 'learn more', 'this', 'this link', 'click', 'go', 'see more', 'view', 'details', 'info'
else content links < 3 AND total internal links < 5
descriptivePercentage, uniqueDestinations (distinct pathnames), navToContentRatio: no score effect
score = max(0, round(score*10)/10); the engine floors it

scoring.status_mapping: Engine rule on the floored score: 4 pass, 2-3 warning, 0-1 fail.

detect.source_procedure: Runs per page on the built HTML in the served root. Collect a[href], classify internal against the page URL built from the site base URL (www and apex are the same site), mark nav links by ancestor nav/header/footer/[role=navigation], compute anchor text (text, else aria-label / img alt / title) and apply the generic list and the count rules. Whether targets exist is out of scope (the /aeotester:links skill does that).

parity.note: The extension sees the rendered DOM including JS-injected links (menus, related posts widgets, CMS content) and uses innerText (hidden text excluded, CSS text-transform can apply). Link hrefs built from variables or data files need resolution. Exact hostname comparison depends on the live host (www vs apex, preview domains), so absolute links to the canonical domain can count as external when the audited URL uses a different host.

fix_summary: Add at least 3 in-content internal links (outside nav/header/footer) to related pages with descriptive anchor text, and replace generic anchors ('read more', 'click here', icon-only links) with descriptive text or visually hidden text in the link. The plugin can rewrite generic anchors using the target page title automatically, but choosing which pages to link needs user or model judgment.

divergences.extension: Image-only links have empty innerText and count as generic anchors even when the image has alt text.
divergences.plugin: When a link has no text, its aria-label, img alt or title is used as the anchor text.
divergences.reason: Cards and logos with alt text have descriptive accessible names; penalising them was a false positive.

divergences.extension: Hostname must equal window.location.hostname exactly, so www.example.com and example.com are different sites.
divergences.plugin: A leading 'www.' is ignored on both sides.
divergences.reason: www and apex are the same site; links between them were miscounted as external.

divergences.extension: The page host is the live URL the user is visiting.
divergences.plugin: The page host comes from the site base URL (canonical, og:url, sitemap, CNAME or framework config); without one, only relative links count as internal.
divergences.reason: Source-vs-live: the plugin reads the repo and has no live URL.

divergences.extension: Status comes from the unfloored score (e.g. 4.5 is pass) while the reported score is floored.
divergences.plugin: Status is derived from the reported integer score by the shared 80% / 50% rule.
